BiblicalUsage: Giba is a place in Palestine, named once in Scripture, in 1 Chronicles. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Giba matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Giba is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
